HARVEST ADVISORY — Kasibu
Rainfall of 22.6 mm may disrupt ongoing harvest operations.
Recommended actions:
1. Advise farmers to assess field conditions before deploying machinery.
2. Coordinate with RCEF mechanization pool for mobile dryer deployment.
3. Issue tarpaulin assistance where needed.
4. Document areas where harvest was deferred for scheduling follow-up.

Extreme rainfall (112.4 mm/24h) requires immediate action:
1. Advise farmers to suspend all field operations immediately.
2. Coordinate with MDRRMC for damage assessment teams.
3. Pre-position tarpaulins and drying facilities.
4. Activate emergency seed replacement protocols.
5. Document affected crop areas for PCIC crop insurance filing.
